finding.evidence: docs/design/sheets/formula.md new "Limitations" paragraph mentions only `extractFormulaRanges` skipping unbounded refs. The grammar change makes `A:A`/`1:1`/`A1:B` valid tokens everywhere, but the diff does not touch `shiftFormula`/`shiftSref`/`parseRange` call sites (still exported from packages/sheets/src/index.ts alongside `extractReferences`), which call `parseRef`-style parsing on each endpoint and cannot represent a column-only/row-only endpoint. A formula containing `A:A` that is shifted by a row/column insert or deletion is therefore either dropped, thrown on, or silently corrupted — a behavior the design doc neither specifies nor lists as a non-goal.
